name: Brampton / North York Express
description: The express member of the former combined 34/35/36 Brampton family, expanded to all-day, seven-day service in 2015.

timeline.event: The Brampton table identifies 36 and Bramalea express short turns.
36 expanded from peak-only to all-day bidirectional service, seven days weekly.
A standalone Brampton/North York booklet documents the reorganized 36 family.

sources.title: GO Brampton Local / Highway 27 and Highway 427 Express table 34, effective 1 September 2012, routes 34 / 35 / 36
Metrolinx GO Transit Ridership Report, September 2016 (original report, archived by Steve Munro)
GO Brampton / North York table 36, effective 5 January 2019

gaps: Initial launch and all later short-turn change dates are unverified.
The shared booklet’s table 34 title does not make these buses route 34.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
